profile.name: A4S微孔板热封机
profile.description: A4S是一种用于实验室微孔板热封的自动封膜设备，可对PCR板、深孔板或储样板施加受控温度和时间，将封膜材料压合到板口以实现密封。它适用于样品储存、避免蒸发与污染，以及自动化样品处理流程中的板封口步骤。
profile.description_en: The A4S is an automated microplate heat sealer used in laboratories to apply sealing films to microplates under controlled temperature and time conditions. It is used with PCR plates, deep-well plates, or storage plates to create a secure seal for sample storage, evaporation and contamination control, and automated sample-processing workflows.
